metadata.case_name: WU KIN LEUNG v. INCORPORATED OWNERS OF FU TOR LOY SUN CHUEN STAGE 1

plaintiff.occupation_before: carpenter doing formwork at a construction site
plaintiff.expected_occupation_after: resume pre-accident employment as a formwork carpenter

injuries.description: laceration of frontal scalp and had 3 stitches.
source: He sustained a laceration of frontal scalp and had 3 stitches.
injuries.icd_description: Laceration without foreign body of head

injuries.description: a faint scar about 2 cm over the left forehead.
source: Dr. Yu said that the plaintiff had a faint scar about 2 cm over the left forehead.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified superficial injury of part of head

injuries.description: Post Concussional Syndrome with mild memory impairment, personality change and somatic complaints (headache, giddiness, etc.).
source: Dr. Chin was of the opinion that the plaintiff suffered from Post Concussional Syndrome with mild memory impairment, personality change including easy loss of temper, irritability, depressive mood and somantic complaints such as headache, giddiness and epilepsy.

injuries.description: Epilepsy (two epileptic attacks due to the accident).
source: I have found that the plaintiff had 2 epileptic attacks due to the accident.
it seems to me that although he did have 2 epileptic attacks as a result of the accident and hence he does have epilepsy, the epilepsy would be very mild ...
injuries.icd_description: Epilepsy due to injuries to the head

manifestations.description: intermittent bitemporal and frontal headaches of a dragging character and mild intensity
short term memory was mildly impaired
difficulty in concentration and a deterioration in performance of mental tasks
change in personality, becoming easily irritable, frustrated
2 epileptic attacks / seizures (episodes in April 2000 and June 2000 as stated)
a faint scar about 2 cm over the left forehead
unable to work at unprotected height because of epilepsy

treatments_received: Treatment at Accident and Emergency Department of Kwong Wah Hospital
regular medication from August 2000 for Post Concussional Syndrome

losses.description: Mild memory impairment and difficulty in concentration.
Easy loss of temper, irritability and depressive mood.
A faint scar about 2 cm over the left forehead.
Unable to work on heights because of his epilepsy.
